name: What is childbirth malpractice and when should I consider contacting a lawyer?

mainEntity.name: What is childbirth malpractice and when should I consider contacting a lawyer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Childbirth malpractice occurs when a medical professional's negligence during pregnancy, labor, or delivery causes injury to the mother or baby. This can include failing to diagnose a condition, improper use of delivery tools, or delaying a necessary C-section. You should consider contacting a lawyer if you suspect your or your baby's injury was preventable and directly caused by a medical error. A lawyer can evaluate your situation, review medical records, and determine if you have a valid claim, helping you understand your legal options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Childbirth malpractice is medical negligence during pregnancy or delivery causing injury. Contact a lawyer if you suspect a preventable injury due to medical error.
